thread:
taylor: T-minus 15 to change window. quick check: any last-minute blockers for quiet period?
lee: infra green, autoscaler warm, disk pressure cleared on prod-nodes.
devops: DB migration deferred to +2h after rollout per safety.
ops-oncall: KMS rotation completed. no cert drift. will monitor key errors.
sdk: Release notes link ready: https://confluence/redwood/releases/3.6.0 — note client compatibility caveat.
taylor: Pin decision: we will pin embeddings-service to emb:v3.6.0 for the quiet window. set replicas=3.
deploy-bot: [11:02] canary start: embeddings:v3.6.0 canary=5% target=3
lee: Watch p95 and 5xx. propose rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% for 4m OR p95 > 1200ms for 3m.
taylor: +1 to that. ops-oncall, add manual quick-unpin steps to playbook.
ops-oncall: Done: /playbooks/quick-unpin.md includes `deploy-bot unpin --service embeddings --version v3.6.0`
deploy-bot: [11:05] canary health: 2/3 healthy, one pod restarted (OOM)
lee: OOM -> looks like new kv cache default higher. redeploy canary with KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB.
taylor: Hold quiet window 10m while we validate redeploy. @sdk notify mobile and web clients.
sdk: Notified @mobile @web teams to pause heavy jobs during canary.
deploy-bot: [11:12] redeploy canary with KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB canary=3%
deploy-bot: [11:18] canary stable: p95=640ms errors=0.2%
taylor: Proceeding to gradual rollout. Keep pin metadata until +30m stable.
deploy-bot: [11:25] rollout: embeddings:v3.6.0 -> 100% over 18m
ops-oncall: SLO watch enabled. alerts routed here and to pager.
deploy-bot: [11:43] rollout complete. health=100% pin=emb-v3.6.0
lee: Post-launch: add a canary memory limiter (followup ENG-7009) and update dashboard thresholds.
ops-oncall: Leaving watch on for 45m. will escalate if any regional regressions.
taylor: If no issues, quiet window lift at +45m. great triage team. :rocket:
